sources.content:
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
from flash_attn import flash_attn_func
import flashinfer.norm


@torch.no_grad()
def run(
    hidden_states, position_ids, attention_mask,
    input_layernorm_weight,
    q_proj_weight, k_proj_weight, v_proj_weight,
    q_norm_weight, k_norm_weight,
    o_proj_weight,
    post_attention_layernorm_weight,
    gate_proj_weight, up_proj_weight, down_proj_weight,
    inv_freq,
    rms_norm_eps, attention_scale,
):
    batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size = hidden_states.shape
    num_attention_heads = 40
    num_key_value_heads = 8
    head_dim = 128

    residual = hidden_states

    # 1. Input RMSNorm via FlashInfer
    x_flat = hidden_states.reshape(-1, hidden_size).contiguous()
    hidden_states = flashinfer.norm.rmsnorm(x_flat, input_layernorm_weight, rms_norm_eps).reshape(
        batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size
    )

    # 2. QKV Projection
    q = F.linear(hidden_states, q_proj_weight)
    k = F.linear(hidden_states, k_proj_weight)
    v = F.linear(hidden_states, v_proj_weight)

    q = q.view(batch_size, seq_len, num_attention_heads, head_dim)
    k = k.view(batch_size, seq_len, num_key_value_heads, head_dim)
    v = v.view(batch_size, seq_len, num_key_value_heads, head_dim)

    # 3. QK Norm via FlashInfer
    q_flat = q.reshape(-1, head_dim).contiguous()
    q = flashinfer.norm.rmsnorm(q_flat, q_norm_weight, rms_norm_eps).reshape(
        batch_size, seq_len, num_attention_heads, head_dim
    )
    k_flat = k.reshape(-1, head_dim).contiguous()
    k = flashinfer.norm.rmsnorm(k_flat, k_norm_weight, rms_norm_eps).reshape(
        batch_size, seq_len, num_key_value_heads, head_dim
    )

    # 4. RoPE
    inv_freq_expanded = inv_freq[None, :, None].float().expand(batch_size, -1, 1)
    position_ids_expanded = position_ids[:, None, :].float()
    freqs = (inv_freq_expanded @ position_ids_expanded).transpose(1, 2)
    emb = torch.cat((freqs, freqs), dim=-1)
    cos = emb.cos().to(torch.bfloat16).unsqueeze(2)  # [batch, seq, 1, head_dim]
    sin = emb.sin().to(torch.bfloat16).unsqueeze(2)

    q1, q2 = q[..., :head_dim // 2], q[..., head_dim // 2:]
    q = (q * cos) + (torch.cat((-q2, q1), dim=-1) * sin)
    k1, k2 = k[..., :head_dim // 2], k[..., head_dim // 2:]
    k = (k * cos) + (torch.cat((-k2, k1), dim=-1) * sin)

    # FlashAttention handles GQA natively + causal
    attn_output = flash_attn_func(
        q.contiguous(), k.contiguous(), v.contiguous(),
        causal=True,
        softmax_scale=attention_scale,
    )
    attn_output = attn_output.reshape(batch_size, seq_len, num_attention_heads * head_dim)

    attn_output = F.linear(attn_output, o_proj_weight)
    hidden_states = residual + attn_output
    residual = hidden_states

    # Post-attn RMSNorm
    x_flat = hidden_states.reshape(-1, hidden_size).contiguous()
    hidden_states = flashinfer.norm.rmsnorm(x_flat, post_attention_layernorm_weight, rms_norm_eps).reshape(
        batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size
    )

    # SwiGLU MLP
    gate = F.linear(hidden_states, gate_proj_weight)
    up = F.linear(hidden_states, up_proj_weight)
    intermediate = F.silu(gate) * up
    mlp_output = F.linear(intermediate, down_proj_weight)

    return residual + mlp_output
